label: GB-equality-act-2010 Section 91

obligations.text:
(1)
The responsible body of an institution to which this section applies must not discriminate against a person—
(a)
in the arrangements it makes for deciding who is offered admission as a student;

(2)
The responsible body of such an institution must not discriminate against a student—
(a)
in the way it provides education for the student;

(3)
The responsible body of such an institution must not discriminate against a disabled person—
(a)
in the arrangements it makes for deciding upon whom to confer a qualification;

(5)
The responsible body of such an institution must not harass—
(a)
a student;

(6)
The responsible body of such an institution must not victimise a person—
(a)
in the arrangements it makes for deciding who is offered admission as a student;

(7)
The responsible body of such an institution must not victimise a student—
(a)
in the way it provides education for the student;

(8)
The responsible body of such an institution must not victimise a disabled person—
(a)
in the arrangements it makes for deciding upon whom to confer a qualification;
